dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted or persisted.
prepare and validate have no structured entry or completion logging.
Evidence, prompt, invocation, and claim validation precede writes.
Evidence drift, missing data, tampering, strictness, and workspace behavior are tested.
Preparation and validation are deterministic persistence-only transformations.
Model does not invoke an external API.
No workspace or external handle is created.
Docs and tests use synthetic example.test data.
Public, nested, and persisted contracts are strict.
Both resources declare infinite lifetime and GC retention.
Assessment gate pipeline, not external CRUD.
Request and validated-gate names are spec-prefixed.
